model: Hierarchical atom-environment minimum-count histogram-intersection kernel SVC/SVR
hypothesis: Count-dot-product similarities allow repeated common motifs to dominate and hash collisions merge environments. Exact hierarchical atom labels and minimum-count matching preserve atom multiplicities and shared shallow chemistry across new scaffolds. This geometric hypothesis is separate from point-network capacity or a downward residual correction.
distinct_from_completed_routes: v104/v150 sparse circular/path kernels used dot-based generalized Tanimoto. v139/v233 used Tanimoto and RBF sum/product or supervised alignment. v172/v175 optimized learned GNN states. This route computes exact discrete WL labels levels0..3 and explicit threshold-lift intersections with fit-only vocabulary/rarity weights; no existing models/prediction reuse.
task_rationale: Three MAE tasks with viable nonconcentrated original confirmation scaffold groups; hERG and hepatocyte are low raw-score endpoints with adequate original scaffold coverage. Excludes structurally infeasible AMES, concentrated LD50/solubility, and near-ceiling BBB/PGP. v249 review forbids simple mean-bias or repeated physical-prior corrections.
atom_labels: Atomic number,isotope,formal charge,aromaticity,degree,totalH,CIP R/S if available,ring flag. Edge bondtype/aromaticity/conjugation/EZ. SHA256 recursively refines label plus sorted neighbour pairs. Full input graph preserved, unusual valence parsed by original parser.
kernel: Each of4depths: fit-only WL label vocabulary and count maxima; indicator levels1..count with sqrt(min(4,1+log((n+1)/(df+1)))) coefficients. Inner product=sum rarity*min(countA,countB),normalized by explicit feature norm. Average depths .75; augmented fit-scaled physicalRBF .15 and target-excluded assayRBF .10. No supervised kernel tuning.
training: Deterministic sklearn SVC(C3,tol1e-5) for hERG, SVR(C3,epsilon.04,tol1e-5) for regressions. Fit-only median/IQR MAE transform or rank-normalized Spearman. No random model seeds/earlystopping/query label access.
scheduling: Single CPU worker,4thread env,5tasks10developmentmodels. Worker exit0 before original v148 selector, then only frozen nominees get confirmation. No GPU training required.
selection: Original v148 max-min fold0/1,unique config/.2or.45 weight frozen before confirmation.
confirmation: Original all4 pointgains>0,original mean practical threshold,bothfold2/valid500drawscaffoldbootstrap90lower>0,no fallback.
verification: Independent manual minimum-count kernel reference/PSD;query-only count and vocabulary invariance;atom-order and stereochemical notation invariance;3metric query-label perturbation/actualsave-reload/roworder. Accepted independent atom environment derivation from original SMILES plus full feature/model/gate/fusion/byte/hash/archive checks.
limitations: Repeated public labels and approximate upstream historical controls remain. Exact atom matching is a distinct hypothesis, not proof of better hidden-test performance.
